description: This file defines the interface for a low-level string buffer structure (`strbuf`) and its associated functions for managing dynamic strings, including initialization, release, attachment, detachment, resizing, and string manipulation operations. It provides the data structure and function prototypes for handling string buffers in C with features like trimming, encoding, formatting, and file I/O.

classes.name: strbuf
classes.description: Structure representing a dynamic string buffer with fields for allocated size (`alloc`), current length (`len`), and a character pointer to the buffer (`buf`).

methods.name: strbuf_init
methods.description: Initializes a strbuf instance with a specified allocation size.

methods.name: strbuf_release
methods.description: Releases the memory held by the strbuf and resets it to an empty state.

methods.name: strbuf_detach
methods.description: Detaches the internal string buffer from the strbuf, transferring ownership to the caller.

methods.name: strbuf_attach
methods.description: Attaches an externally allocated string to the strbuf, taking ownership.

methods.name: void strbuf_swap(struct strbuf * a,struct strbuf * b)
methods.description: Swaps the contents of two strbuf structures.

methods.name: size_t strbuf_avail(const struct strbuf * sb)
methods.description: Returns the amount of remaining allocated space after the current string length.

methods.name: strbuf_grow
methods.description: Ensures the buffer has at least a specified amount of free space, reallocating if necessary.

methods.name: void strbuf_setlen(struct strbuf * sb,size_t len)
methods.description: Sets the length of the string buffer, adjusting the null terminator accordingly.

methods.name: strbuf_reset
methods.description: Empties the buffer by setting its length to zero.

methods.name: strbuf_trim
methods.description: Removes whitespace from both ends of the buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_rtrim
methods.description: Removes whitespace from the end of the buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_ltrim
methods.description: Removes whitespace from the beginning of the buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_trim_trailing_dir_sep
methods.description: Removes trailing directory separators from the buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_trim_trailing_newline
methods.description: Removes trailing newline characters from the buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_reencode
methods.description: Reencodes the string in the buffer from one encoding to another.

methods.name: strbuf_tolower
methods.description: Converts all characters in the buffer to lowercase.

methods.name: strbuf_cmp
methods.description: Compares two strbufs lexicographically.

methods.name: void strbuf_addch(struct strbuf * sb,int c)
methods.description: Adds a single character to the end of the buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_addchars
methods.description: Adds a specified number of a particular character to the buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_insert
methods.description: Inserts data at a specified position in the buffer.

methods.name: void strbuf_insertstr(struct strbuf * sb,size_t pos,const char * s)
methods.description: Inserts a null-terminated string at a specified position.

methods.name: strbuf_vinsertf
methods.description: Inserts formatted data at a specified position using a va_list.

methods.name: strbuf_insertf
methods.description: Inserts formatted data at a specified position.

methods.name: strbuf_remove
methods.description: Removes a segment of data from the buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_splice
methods.description: Replaces a segment of the buffer with new data.

methods.name: strbuf_add_commented_lines

methods.name: strbuf_add
methods.description: Appends raw data to the buffer.

methods.name: void strbuf_addstr(struct strbuf * sb,const char * s)
methods.description: Appends a null-terminated string to the buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_addstrings
methods.description: Appends multiple copies of a string to the buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_addbuf

methods.name: humanise_bytes

methods.name: humanise_count
